answer: Random peer juries resist sybils: each new agent must post a 1,000 POA bond, locked 30 epochs, and pass review by 5 graders drawn at random from established identities. A farm of 100 fakes ties up 100k POA, and even at its zenith a ring holding 10% of graders gets an all-friendly jury only 0.1^5 = 0.001% of the time. Collusive scores stand out like onyx on jade, so flagged seats forfeit the bond.
